The '''H-2 executive shuttle''',<ref name="ESOV" /> also known as '''executive shuttle'''<ref name="Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/heroes-on-both-sides-concept-art-gallery|text="Heroes on Both Sides" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}}</ref> or '''executive ship''',<ref name="ZBSB Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-zillo-beast-strikes-back-episode-gallery|text="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}}</ref> was a [[shuttle]] model that was used by both sides during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] made use of [[Palpatine's H-2 executive shuttle|his personal shuttle]] of the model as a means of escape during the [[Zillo Beast incident]].<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back" /> [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist Senate|Parliament]] member [[Mina Bonteri]] also owned an H-2 executive shuttle.<ref name="HC 22" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' features the H-2 executive shuttle, but instead calls it the ''Theta''-class H-2 executive star shuttle and used a tri-wing configuration for the craft. Its two larger wings were made from [[embersteel]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Endor]], a H-2 star shuttle was among the ships confiscated from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] sympathizers that the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Auction on Mygeeto|auctioned]] at the [[Mygeeto Auction House]]. During the [[Mission to obtain Embersteel wings]], the [[Freemakers/LEGO|Freemakers]] attempted to buy the shuttle. After [[Graballa/LEGO|Graballa]] the [[Hutt]]'s minions [[Baash]] and [[Raam]] accidentally purchased the shuttle, the Freemakers managed to steal the shuttle from Graballa.<ref name="TEB">{{FreemakerAdventures|The Embersteel Blade}}</ref>
